## Configuration

```{python}
from pathlib import Path
import os
import sys

import pandas as pd

root = Path.cwd()
if root.name == "notebooks":
    root = root.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(root / "src"))

from ards_cxr_benchmark.probabilistic_benchmark import (
    run_probabilistic_benchmark,
    write_probabilistic_benchmark_outputs,
)

reference_path = Path(
    os.environ.get(
        "ARDS_PROB_REFERENCE",
        root / "tests" / "fixtures" / "probabilistic_case_reference.csv",
    )
)
prediction_path = Path(
    os.environ.get(
        "ARDS_PROB_PREDICTIONS",
        root / "tests" / "fixtures" / "probabilistic_predictions.csv",
    )
)
synthetic_mode = "ARDS_PROB_REFERENCE" not in os.environ and "ARDS_PROB_PREDICTIONS" not in os.environ
artifact_dir = root / "artifacts" / "benchmark"
if synthetic_mode:
    artifact_dir = artifact_dir / "synthetic"

reference_path, prediction_path
```

## Load Reference And Predictions

```{python}
reference = pd.read_parquet(reference_path) if reference_path.suffix == ".parquet" else pd.read_csv(reference_path)
predictions = pd.read_parquet(prediction_path) if prediction_path.suffix == ".parquet" else pd.read_csv(prediction_path)

reference
```

```{python}
predictions
```

## Run Benchmark

```{python}
result = run_probabilistic_benchmark(reference, predictions, n_bins=3)
result.join_audit
```
